svg.title: More features
svg.desc: The seven current More features commands in menu order, with their purposes and prerequisites. Command guide illustration, not a screenshot. No live user data.
svg.metadata: Source: addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.xml; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.cs; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/LOKAL.PowerPoint.csproj; assets/*.png. Purposes checked against Ribbon callbacks and active UI sources. Authored as a code-native SVG command guide. Existing PNG icons embedded without external image references. Commands using Office imageMso icons are represented by a plain Office label, not a substitute icon.
svg.text: LOKAL / POWERPOINT ADD-IN
More features
Command guide · illustration, not a screenshot
LOKAL / More / More features
Timer
Open the countdown timer or stopwatch.
Start, pause, reset, and choose an alarm.
Name Picker
Pick class participants with a card or wheel.
Use picked history, put back names, and award stars.
Office
Quick Poll
Run True/False, Yes/No/Unsure, Feedback, or custom choices.
Starts during a slideshow; no answer key or automatic quiz stars.
Leaderboard
Show current-session or cumulative class stars.
Display rankings and insert the leaderboard as a slide.
Class groups
Manage groups for the selected class.
Create groups manually or distribute participants randomly.
Draggable Objects
Mark selected shapes, pictures, or text boxes in edit view.
Move them in a slideshow with the toolbar’s draggable hand.
Office
Share PDF
Save a fixed-format PDF copy of the presentation.
The active PowerPoint deck keeps its original format.
Current menu order. Plain Office badges stand in for built-in Office icons.
